full_judgment: 19. In the face of the record, it is clear that the framing of charge by the Special Judge, Mymensingh on 20.02.2001 being illegal has vitiated the trial on the ground of misjoinder of charges. High court Division is quite competent to interfere in a case of misjoinder of charges under Articles 98 of the Constitution as held by the Full Bench in the case of Abdul Kuddus 13 DLR 213. This misjoinder of charge is an illegality not curable under section 537.
